svg.text: ZX Spectrum 128K · 64 KB address space of the Z80 · eight 16 KB RAM banks, paged in at C000 through port 7FFD · build 0.19
Free: core 48 B · bank 0 934 B · bank 4 288 B · bank 6 100 B · bank 3 253 B. Every paged bank keeps the IM2 vector table and JP isr at FDFD; calls between banks go through BCALL in the fixed code.
